verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build tool, so filtering installs and scripts to a subset of workspace packages, or only to those affected by a change, is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never documents workspace filtering or change-affected selection. It covers only dev shells (nix-shell, nix develop), building and running flakes, and binary caching, none of which is per-package workspace filtering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run installs and scripts filtered to a subset of workspace packages (including only those affected by a change)
